decisions.reason: Report attributes the sole crash to plugin A's SessionProgressBar, quotes the console TypeError, and explains that alpha.2 standard props dropped useSessionPendingInteraction (replaced by useSessionStatus, useSessions unchanged), grounded in the two slots-contract excerpts; plugin B is correctly cleared and the two-symptoms-as-independent reading is explicitly rejected.

Grounded in dock-render-tree.md: both entries share one DrawerErrorBoundary in conversation.input.dock, so A's render throw unmounts the whole subtree including B's chips; the attach button survives in conversation.input.left under its own boundary, supported by the console line naming both unmounted entries.

Interprets the toggle experiment as proving A causes the unmount and B renders once freed, while explicitly noting it does not prove B is fully alpha.2-compatible nor that the crash is the only dock defect; explains reinstalling B was futile (B never broken) and refutes the colleague's both-plugins-hit theory because B uses no standard-kit hooks.

Provides corrected component code reading pending state via useSessionStatus(...).pendingInteraction with optional chaining and stable empty fallbacks so only the pending indicator hides while running/todos/token/ETA keep working, and explains silent degradation via the shared-boundary blast radius (cosmetic gap vs multi-plugin outage); also guards the legacy hook.

Verification needs no host restart (refresh re-fetches client bundles), checks both entries render together under the dock boundary, and specifies a B regression covering paste/remove/re-paste including while A's strip re-renders; hygiene covers defensive destructuring/feature detection and host-side per-entry boundaries with honest trade-offs.

caps.reason: The final remedy fixes plugin A only (migration plus graceful degradation in SessionProgressBar); plugin B is correctly identified as the unbroken victim, and per-entry host boundaries are proposed as optional hygiene, not as a fix to B or a claim of two independent plugin bugs.
